data.body:
[rebar-debug RCA] Disposition: DUPLICATE — already fixed and verified green on main.

INVESTIGATION (worktree at origin/main d007c76b53d5)

Step 0 sweep found a sibling: microbian-swimming-woodstorks (0d22-f664-77e1-495f),
"Linux bwrap enforcement has no gating CI lane (tests skip silently)". It was created
2026-08-27 18:40 UTC — 11 minutes AFTER this ticket (18:29 UTC) — and both are
discovered_from the same epic e668 (chiffon-venomous-annelida). woodstorks describes the
identical defect this ticket reports and it landed the fix.

FIX ALREADY IN MAIN. Commit d44bd253ee44 ("Gate Linux bwrap enforcement on a real lane",
rebar-ticket: 0d22-f664-77e1-495f) adds a gating `sandbox-enforcement` job to
.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml (line 300). That job:
- runs the @live enforcement tests inside a `docker run --privileged` container where
  bwrap CAN create a namespace, with REBAR_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_ENFORCEMENT=1 so a missing
  mechanism FAILS the lane instead of skipping;
- asserts a liveness-checked precondition first ("Prove bwrap can namespace and enforce"):
  the outside-deny probe must exit non-zero and the file must be absent, or the lane fails.

GATING. `_build-and-test.yml` is `uses:`-called by gerrit-verify.yaml (the Verified gate,
whose final gate `needs: [... build-and-test ...]`) and by test.yml (post-merge branch CI).
A reusable workflow passes only if all its jobs pass, so `sandbox-enforcement` is gating.

VERIFICATION (this session):
- Latest main run of test.yml (33191798917, 2026-08-28 16:49 UTC): job
  "build-and-test / sandbox enforcement (Linux bwrap, gating)" = success. (The run's overall
  failure is unrelated `sweep (...)` jobs from compact-sweep.yml.)
- Local `pytest tests/scripts/test_mutation_sandbox.py` on macOS: 43 passed, 1 skipped;
  every @live enforcement test EXECUTED (Seatbelt), the 1 skip being the lane-only guard
  `test_a_mechanism_is_required_when_the_lane_says_so` (skips off-lane by design).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — all met by woodstorks's landed work:
- AC1 (observed executing on Linux, outside-deny probe non-zero, file absent) → the
  privileged lane + its precondition step do exactly this; green on run 33191798917.
- AC2 (record the resolution when GitHub ubuntu can't grant namespaces) → recorded: a
  `--privileged` OCI container (a runtime capability, not a CI-provider feature), measured on
  ubuntu:24.04/bwrap 0.9.0 (default & seccomp-unconfined UNUSABLE; --privileged ENFORCING).
- AC3 (skip made LOUD) → REBAR_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_ENFORCEMENT=1 turns the @live skip into a
  hard failure, plus test_a_mechanism_is_required_when_the_lane_says_so.
- AC4 (resolve the b63cf799 / a26a73277c8a contradiction) → resolved in a26a's direction:
  unprivileged GitHub ubuntu runners cannot enforce (b63cf799's rationale that the pytest-cell
  install would make them EXECUTE was wrong); real enforcement now runs on the dedicated
  privileged lane. Documented in d44bd253's message and the woodstorks ticket.

CONCLUSION. The reported defect does not reproduce on current main because it is already
fixed. No code change is warranted. This ticket is a duplicate of woodstorks (0d22-f664);
linking `duplicates` and closing as --class=duplicate.
